† טִבְחָה n.f. thing slaughtered, slaughtered meat, slaughter—
1. sf. טִבְחָתִי as acc. cogn. after טָבַח 1 S 25:11 of meat killed for food.
2. slaughter for food (= i. טֶבַח 1): כְּצֹאן ט׳ ψ 44:23 like a flock for slaughter, sim. of the harassed godly; כְּצֹאן לְטִבְחָה Je 12:3 sim. of judgment of wicked (‖ לְיוֹם הֲרֵגָה).
